question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $M$ given by

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 40 \\ -1 & -2 & 25\end{array}\right].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce $M$ to row echelon form, and then solve the linear system represented by the matrix.
question.:question/worked-solution:
Reducing $M$ to row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 40 \\ -1 & -2 & 25\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+1\cdot {R}_{1} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 40 \\ 0 & -1 & 65\end{array}\right] & {R}_{2} & :=-1\cdot {R}_{2} \\  & ∼\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}1 & 1 & 40 \\ 0 & 1 & -65\end{array}\right].\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y &=40 \\ y &=-65\end{aligned}\right.
$$

and we can apply back substitution. The final equation $y=-65$ tells us the value of $y.$ Substituting this value into the first equation, we get

$$
x+\left(-65\right)=40\,\Rightarrow\,x=40+65=105.
$$

Therefore, the solution is $x=105$ and $y=-65.$
